name: column-only-receipts-inventory
ddl: CREATE TABLE app_settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
CREATE TABLE receipt (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, body BLOB NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE history (receipt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES receipt(id), body BLOB NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER receipt_history AFTER INSERT ON receipt BEGIN INSERT INTO history VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.body, NEW.revision); END
CREATE TABLE inventory (sku TEXT NOT NULL, environment TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER, provenance TEXT, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(environment, sku))
CREATE TABLE catalog (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX inventory_quantity ON inventory(environment, quantity)

reads.sql: SELECT key,value,updated_at FROM app_settings ORDER BY key
SELECT r.id,hex(r.body) AS body,h.revision FROM receipt r JOIN history h ON h.receipt_id=r.id ORDER BY r.id
SELECT c.sku,c.title,i.quantity,i.provenance FROM catalog c JOIN inventory i ON c.sku=i.sku WHERE i.environment='test' ORDER BY c.sku
SELECT c.sku,(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory i WHERE i.sku=c.sku) AS locations FROM catalog c ORDER BY c.sku
SELECT environment,count(*) AS rows,sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM inventory GROUP BY environment ORDER BY environment
SELECT quantity,revision FROM inventory WHERE environment='preview' AND sku='0007'

mutations.sql: UPDATE inventory SET quantity=4,revision=revision+1 WHERE environment='test' AND sku='0012' AND revision=1 RETURNING quantity,revision
INSERT INTO app_settings(key,value) VALUES ('locale','en-GB') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value WHERE app_settings.value IS NOT excluded.value RETURNING value
INSERT INTO inventory(sku,environment,quantity,provenance) SELECT sku,'copy',quantity,provenance FROM inventory WHERE environment='test' AND 1 ON CONFLICT(environment,sku) DO NOTHING RETURNING sku

recovery.boundary: committed WAL, process exits without closing connection
